item_damage_per_attack.description: : The amount to damage the item for each attack performed. Defaults to {{cd|1}}.

disable_blocking_for_seconds.description: The amount of seconds that this item can disable a blocking shield on successful attack. If set to 0, this item cannot disable a blocking shield. Defaults to {{cd|0}}.

weapon.description: When present, the specified amount of damage can be done to the item with each attack. Additionally, the 'Item Used' statistic will be incremented for each attack with the item.
